verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain's overview says it supports enforcing your organization's open source package licensing requirements. It also builds a full dependency inventory and generates SBOMs. That is only a single high-level line, with no detail on how licenses are detected or how a policy is set and enforced in scans. Missing for 10: documentation of license detection per dependency, how license policies are configured (allow/deny lists), how violations block or fail CI/PR scans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
